description: Search and analyze Competiscan's direct-mail and marketing intelligence archive.

defaultPrompt: Show me the latest balance transfer offers in credit card mail
What has Capital One been mailing consumers lately?
Compare the checking account bonuses banks are mailing right now
interface.longDescription: Search Competiscan's marketing intelligence archive, retrieve individual campaign pieces, and compare competitive direct-mail activity using the connected Competiscan MCP server.

positive.description: Find recent competitor offers of one type in direct mail and see examples
positive.prompt: Show me the latest balance transfer offers in credit card mail
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of recent credit card mailers featuring balance transfer offers, listing issuer, card and terms (intro APR length, transfer fee where stated), followed by 3-6 piece cards with thumbnails and PDF links. As of October 2026 this included Bank of America (0% intro APR on balance transfers until September 2027) and Commerce Bank (0% for 15 billing cycles).

positive.description: See everything one competitor has mailed recently
positive.prompt: What has Capital One been mailing consumers lately?
positive.expected_behavior: An overview of Capital One's recent direct mail grouped by product line, with 4-6 example piece cards. As of October 2026: Venture Rewards (75,000 bonus miles), Quicksilver, Platinum Mastercard, Savor for Students, Auto Finance pre-approvals, and Discover cards and personal loans marked "a division of Capital One".

positive.description: Compare offer amounts across competitors in one product category
positive.prompt: Compare the checking account bonuses banks are mailing right now
positive.expected_behavior: A comparison table of checking account bonuses from recent bank mail: bank, account, bonus amount and qualifying requirements. As of October 2026: Wells Fargo $400, KeyBank up to $1,200, Fifth Third $450, U.S. Bank up to $450 and Citizens $300, with business checking offers (Wells Fargo $825, Chase $500, KeyBank $500) listed separately.

positive.description: Read and summarize one specific archive piece by its entry ID
positive.prompt: Read piece 2026-09-09-5185 and summarize the offer
positive.expected_behavior: A summary of a Chase Sapphire Preferred acquisition mailer: 100,000 bonus points after $5,000 in purchases in the first 3 months, a $95 annual fee, and a reply-by date of October 19, 2026.

positive.description: Find offers by a structured offer attribute (the type of sign-up bonus)
positive.prompt: Which travel credit cards have been offering bonus miles in the mail recently?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of credit card mailers offering bonus miles at sign-up, with card, bonus and spending requirement, plus example piece cards. As of October 2026: Capital One Venture (75,000 miles), Citi / AAdvantage Globe (65,000 miles after $4,500 in purchases) and United Explorer from Chase (70,000 miles, plus 10,000 for adding an authorized user).

negative.description: Writing new marketing copy from scratch, with no request for competitor examples or archive research. Competiscan should not be called; ChatGPT writes the letter itself.
negative.prompt: Write a direct mail letter announcing our new 0% intro APR balance transfer card

negative.description: A personal request to stop receiving a company's mail. Competiscan is a read-only research archive and cannot act on anyone's accounts or mailing lists, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: Stop Capital One from sending me credit card offers in the mail

negative.description: Tracking a letter or package the user sent. Competiscan archives marketing pieces, not postal shipments, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: Where is the letter I mailed with USPS last Tuesday?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes:
First release of Competiscan for ChatGPT.

- Search 20+ years of real US and Canadian marketing (direct mail, email, digital, social and print) by company, sector, channel, audience, date, keyword, and offer details such as intro APR or sign-up bonus.
- Read the full text of any piece, and see pieces as cards with a thumbnail and a link to the full PDF.
- Built-in research guidance for competitor snapshots, offer comparisons and trends over time.

Requires a Competiscan account.

name: competiscan
